categories.main_business_segments: Huaqin Technology primarily operates in intelligent hardware product development, design, manufacturing, and operational services. Its main business segments include smart terminals (smartphones and wearable devices), high-performance computing (personal computers, tablets, and data products such as servers and switches), AIoT products (smart home, XR, gaming devices), and automotive electronics and industrial products. The company serves diverse industries including consumer electronics, data centers, automotive electronics, and industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced ODM capabilities with core competencies in operation, development, manufacturing, and mechanical precision (ODMM). It possesses strong R&D capabilities in ARM and X86 architectures, end-to-end integrated product development processes, and emphasizes smart manufacturing, lean production, and vertical integration of precision components. Huaqin also invests heavily in AI, embedded software, complex system integration, new materials, and simulation technologies to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huaqin serves leading global brand manufacturers in smartphones, PCs, tablets, smart wearables, servers, and automotive electronics. Its customers include top-tier domestic and international technology companies in consumer electronics, cloud service providers, automotive OEMs, and industrial clients. The company maintains close partnerships with major cloud providers and automotive brands, supporting a broad range of end markets from consumer devices to data centers and intelligent vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant manufacturing and R&D bases in China (Shanghai, Dongguan, Nanchang, Wuxi, Xi'an) and overseas production facilities in Vietnam, India, and Mexico. It has established a 'China+VMI' global supply chain layout to serve customers worldwide. Key overseas subsidiaries and operations exist in Hong Kong, Singapore, India, the US, Japan, Indonesia, and Vietnam, reflecting a broad international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huaqin operates primarily as an Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) and Joint Design Manufacturer (JDM), positioned midstream in the supply chain. It provides end-to-end product development, manufacturing, and operational services, integrating upstream component sourcing and downstream product delivery. The company also engages in vertical integration of precision structural components to enhance supply chain control and product competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on the '3+N+3' intelligent product platform, emphasizing smartphones, personal computers, and data center products as core mature businesses, while expanding into automotive electronics, software, and robotics as new growth areas. It prioritizes technology innovation with substantial R&D investment, advanced manufacturing digitalization, global supply chain resilience, and talent development. Huaqin actively pursues AI, cloud computing, IoT, and smart hardware integration to capture emerging market opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Huaqin generates revenue mainly through product sales of smart terminals, high-performance computing devices, AIoT products, automotive electronics, and industrial hardware. It also earns income from professional services such as project R&D and design. The revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance milestones, with direct sales as the primary sales channel.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huaqin is a global leader in smartphone ODM and a top player in tablet and server ODM markets. Its main competitors include Industrial Fulian (Foxconn), Luxshare Precision, GoerTek, Unigroup, Inspur, Longqi Technology, Desay SV, Quanta Computer, and Compal Electronics. The company ranks fourth in revenue among comparable peers and maintains a strong position through technological innovation, diversified product portfolio, and global supply chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Huaqin achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 109.88 billion, representing a 28.76% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 2.93 billion, up 8.10%. Total assets grew 48.12% to RMB 76.30 billion, and net assets increased 8.04% to RMB 22.54 billion. The company has demonstrated robust growth driven by expansion in high-performance computing and AIoT segments, supported by strategic acquisitions and global manufacturing scale-up.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huaqin emphasizes its comprehensive ODM capabilities combining efficient operations, advanced R&D, smart manufacturing, and precision component integration to deliver high-quality, cost-competitive intelligent hardware products. Its global supply chain resilience, multi-product category expertise, and strong customer relationships enable it to provide tailored, end-to-end solutions. The company’s focus on innovation, especially in AI and automotive electronics, differentiates it as a trusted partner for leading technology brands worldwide.
